API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIReportsGets the application’s metric trend
Gets the application’s metric trend
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/apps/:appid/metrics

Gets the application’s metric trend. For Web Probes, you can access Page Fetch Time, Server Response Time, DNS Time or Availability. If not specified, it defaults to Page Fetch Time (PFT).

For CloudPath Probes, you can access latency metrics for End to End, Client - Egress, Egress - Application, ZIA Service Edge - Egress, and ZIA Service Edge - Application. If not specified, it defaults to End to End latency.

If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
appid
integer
REQUIRED

The application ID assigned by ZDX. For example, 12 for Microsoft Teams Call Quality.

Example: 12
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

metric_name
string

Possible values: [pft, dns, availability]

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
metric
string

The name of the metric (for example, PFT).

unit
string

The unit of the metric.

datapoints
object[]
]
